author: MonkeySlap
body:
DISCLAIMER:

The purpose of this intricate thread is not to disrespect Avicus in any way.
Nor to be overly-critical or skeptic.
I am trying to outline the faults of Avicus
And Correct Them.
I also would prefer it if Sr. Staff would not lock the thread. I want this to be an ongoing discussion.
Great, I think that handles my disclaimer. Now let's start casting this puppy.

Okay, to not sound like a jackass, I'm going to start out with some of the "UPS" of Avicus.
  • Absolutely beautiful gamemodes. I mean, we got the whole damn jumble here. We got CTF, DTC, KOTH, etc.
  • Staff members with quick, fair judgement, a fun personality, and a scary time of activity (#AvicusStaffAreRobots)
  • The "Original, Unspoiled" feel: No chat filter, no anticheat, etc.
  • Not overly graphic (No overwhelming colors)
  • A fair protocol (But is it too fair? Read on to find out!)
  • A beautiful lobby, or '/hub'
  • A cool community
  • An awesome ip: Avic.us (You got the name in, you bastard)
  • A professional looking forum page
  • COMPLETELY Play2Win NOT PAY2WIN
You know what? I'm writing this and thinking 'I can spend all day writing the "UPS" of Avicus. This thread is about the "DOWNS" and how to correct them.'

And you know what?
That is exactly what you're going to get.

Here are some of the few "DOWNS" of Avicus, and how to correct each and every one of them.
  • The first one - and in my opinion the most disturbing - is Avicus's protocol on Pornography Advertising. The immediate action taken by Pornography Advertisers, is an immediate permanent ban. But that's just it. The advertiser is banned. In a big offense - Not caps, spam, etc. - not only should the offender be punished, but the offense has to be wiped from existence. With somebody spitting out Pornography Links, even if the advertiser is banned, the link is still in chat. PEOPLE!!! CHILDREN PLAY THIS GAME!!! The link is still in the chat! Who cares if the guy is banned? The punishment is just making sure it won't happen again!
How to solve it:
This one is easy. The second a staff member sees a pornography link, the staff member should immediately clear the chat. Again, children play this game. You don't want children viewing pornography. Okay, now you're thinking, "But Monkey, if the porno link is cleared, how will staff get evidence???" Well, child, there's such a thing as server logs. Each time you click the "Enter" key on a message, it is immediately imputed into a file in the server logs. This, and player logs. Each time you send out a message, each player saves a copy into player logs as well. Evidence is easily achieved. So, in the case of a pornography advertiser, not only should the advertiser be banned, but the chat should be immediately cleared to prevent child pornography viewing. People, a '/cc' plugin is free! Download one!
  • Okay, my next one is about the way that Hackers can be unbanned due to chance. By "Chance", I mean corrupted evidence. In case you didn't know, every time someone is banned for hacking, or pornography advertising and such, evidence must be obtained in case the hacker appeals, saying that he/she never committed the offense. If the hacker does this, the staff member who banned them would just reply with evidence, and the hacker would not be unbanned. However. If the evidence file becomes corrupted. And the hacker appeals. The hacker is then unbanned. True, I cannot think off the top of my head a situation like this one, but it is still a problem.
How to solve it:
This is a bit complicated. Let me start out by saying that staff members need to have some level of trust. Meaning, that staff  members deserve some credibility. If a hacker does appeal, and the evidence file is corrupted, then certain actions must be taken that the hacker does not rejoin. My solution is that 3+ staff members would sign off on him being guilty. What I'm saying is that 3+ staff members (All staff, including ref's) would have to reply to the appeal thread, with evidence that they were indeed online at the time that the hacker was banned (this evidence is easily obtained in the timespot in the server logs), and they would have to swear their staff careers that the hacker was indeed, hacking. Once 3 or more staff members have done this, and submitted evidence, the appeal would be denied.
  • A third problem, is a small one on the forums. Thread making. You have little to no options in making creative threads. Looking up, I see only Bolding, Italic, Underline, Unordered List, Ordered List, Outdent, Indent, Edit HTML, Links, Images, and Tags. I don't understand. Where are the colors? The text sizes? We are awfully limited in what we can do and type.
How to solve it:
Oh, this is easy: Just add more options
  • Wrapping up, another problem I find in Avicus is the fact that there is no anticheat. On popular servers, there's usually an anticheat that disables fly, disables anti knockback, disables scaffoldwalk, etc. On Avicus, all hacks are able to be executed. Another problem with an anticheat, is that staff are the only anticheat on Avicus. Meaning, if no staff are on, hackers can absolutely grill the server. Meaning, only Moderator+ has '/ban' to ban hackers. So if there is no Mod+ on, who is there to stop hackers from making the community leave the server. No one. Absolutely no one protects Avicus.
How to solve it:
This one is easy as well: Just add in an anticheat.
  • My final last example is on Ranks. Think about it. The cheapest rank is Gold. Gold is $30.00 USD. Few want to buy a $30.00 rank right off the bat. That's a lot of money for E-Commerce. And for what? Joining a team of your choice? Joining a full game? YES. I bought Gold, and it was completely worth it. However, new players don't know this. They will stay unranked instead of buying Gold.
How to solve it:
Make a line of Cosmetic Ranks. If you don't know, Cosmetic ranks are ranks that hold no PvP advantages, but instead either look cool or impressive. Sometimes both. Cosmetic ranks are usually dirt cheap. Tags are a good idea too. Not overly colored tags with &k's, but colors. Tags. Cosmetic ranks. Not the stuff in the lobby, but the stuff in game. I think it would make Avicus a lot of dough, and after people buy Cosmetic Ranks, they will go straight to Gold.

Thank you so much for reading through my extensive thread.
I greatly encourage you to reply with something you agreed with, or disagreed with, and a reason or so. If you are a staff member interested in these ideas, please reply down below.

Stay "tuned" till my next thread for "How To Correct Avicus's Faults P2: Interview with Sr. Staff."

Thanks again! #MonkeyForHelper
-MonkeySlap

replies.author: KojaCola
replies.body:
Hey Monkey! 

I love that you are making a lot of suggestions!! Here are a few ideas/responses:


1. Pornography should not be allowed whatsoever. I agree with this one. 

2. By no means are hackers unbanned due to chance. Corrupted files can happen, and yes, it isn't good but there is no good way to solve this. I also agree with the first part. Your solution seems a little complicated though... If the three people did not see the evidence, how will they know which way to vote? Also, if the voters have evidence to use in their vote, why do they need to vote in the first place?!?

3. You do have some liberties with making threads, but I feel if given too many options, the forums would be filled with hundreds of different colors, making the posts harder to read.

4. Avicus technically does not have an anti cheat plugin (I think... correct me if I'm wrong), but Avicus uses the moderators+ as he anticheat. I understand it can be frustrating if there are hackers with no mods on, but there are a number of things you can do to help. It may not seem like it, but all players can "protect" Avicus. The first thing to do is to record evidence if possible. After recorded, upload to youtube, and send to moderators via discord/skype/other. If you don't have contact info of mods, you can also upload via Avicus forums via "Player Reports". If you can't record, the best thing you can do is try to have someone else in game record, and also contact moderators. If you can't do anything above, the best thing to do is try your best to maintain a calm chat. The worst thing after a hacker is when people start spamming "hacker!". This will just hurt the server more, so try to keep the chat calm! 

5. Cosmetic ranks. I like this idea, but the ranks are already cosmetic only, and you can buy many cosmetic items in the shop in lobby as well as on the online shop. If we start having people using colors for their names, or using nicknames, it will be nearly impossible to read that chat and for moderators to identify who the players are. 

Anyway, I really like this post, and it has a lot of good content. 

Koja.

replies.author: MonkeySlap
replies.body:
#1: Pornography is already not allowed. What I am saying, is that if a pornography advertiser "Strikes", then the chat should be immediately cleared. Avicus doesn't have a clearchat plugin, so I'm saying that one should be integrated.

#2: When I say "Chance": I mean "Chance" by corrupted files. What I am saying with my solution, is that three people aren't swearing they saw the evidence. They are swearing they saw the offense. And the evidence part is not evidence of the offense. It is evidence that they were online at the time of the offense, along with the two other staff members that are swearing that they saw the offense.

#3: Options are good. While I completely agree with you that overly graphic is... overly graphic, I still feel that Avicus forum options are extremely limited. You ever wonder why I only type in Bold? It makes me stand out, and I think that other players want to stand out too. Look on Mineplex. All over, you see some of my beautiful threads. Colors and Bolding are a sign of art. You don't want to make a thread with only good content. You also want to make it look cool so people keep reading.

#4: Avicus needs to integrate one. Absolutely has to. I mean, back in my Hacking Days (Not on Avicus tho), me and a friend used to grill this server that had little staff and no anticheat. There was nothing the users could do about it. I like the idea of the Console Autobanning Ban Evaders, but there is no anticheat for hackers. I know the protocol for recording + posting, but if a mod isn't on Minecraft, what are the odds he's on the Forums, ready to open a report thread? I'm actually trying to get the contact info of a mod. And the thing that "Staff Members are the Anticheat?" Please. No offense to you guys, but staff members aren't perfect. Sometimes they slip up. Sometimes they miss something. Anticheats... really don't. The only reason that I would accept as to why there is no anticheat, would be that an anticheat causes lag.

#5: If the ranks are cosmetic already, then they should be cheaper. In my opinion, $30 is WAY too much for the smallest rank. Perhaps, $3.00 or $5.00 tags would be in order. They look cool, and are cool. I am NOT suggesting we integrate the NickName plugin. I hate it. THAT is how you make it nearly impossible to read the chat.

If you have any more questions or concerns that I can address, please reply back to this thread!
Thanks!
-MonkeySlap
#MonkeyForHelper
Look out for my P2 part of the thread, where I will be interviewing an Anonymous Sr. Staff

Thank you for commenting on my extensive thread!
I consider a website or a server to be overly graphic, exactly that. Overly graphic. To the point where I don't want to play on it anymore.
For instance, take this site: http://webbyawards.com/
Looking right at it, Webby Awards is covered in graphics, and photographs. Enough so, that when I had to do a school project, I immediately asked for a different website because this one is too overly graphic. Same thing with Minecraft. When I say Overly Graphic, I mean like Mineplex. Hypixel. Those mumbo-jumbos. WAAAAAAY too many cosmetics. Waaaaaay too many colors. BOOM CRASH!!! SOUND FX!!! OHHHH THE PAIN!!!! I can't stand it. So that's why I compliment Avicus on being NOT too overly graphic.
Thank you for replying, and if you have any more questions don't hesitate to reply again. Keep an eye out for my next thread, where I will be interviewing a Sr. Staff on the dirt of Avicus. -MonkeySlap
